stanza: My body was sharp, the dark air clean
And outrage my joyful companion
And whispering women, how sweet did they seem
Kneeling for me to command them

companion.songTitle: If You See Me Getting Smaller
stanza: Willie, you're my constant companion
You know the light and shade
We have spent a million dollars
To find out what we've made
We have made the maidens marvel
At the things we do and say
Down, down and out, brother
Singin' "Up, Up and Away"

canyon.line: All the ladies of the canyon
stanza: All the ladies of the canyon
Wearing black to their house parties
Crosby, Stills and Nash is playing
Wine is flowing with Bacardi

canyon.line: And it echoed through the canyons
stanza: In the park, I saw a daddy
With a laughing little girl who he was swingin'
And I stopped beside a Sunday school
And listened to the song that they were singin'
Then I headed back for home
And somewhere far away a lonely bell was ringin'
And it echoed through the canyons
Like the disappearing dreams of yesterday

canyon.line: And it's one more day up in the canyons
stanza: And it's one more day up in the canyons
And it's one more night in Hollywood
If you think that I could be forgiven
I wish you would
